what: A screen-height cell cuts out a photo pinned to the screen like a window (clip-path inset(0) + inner panel position: fixed), and while the cell exits the top of the screen the photo returns from 1.2× scale and 40% shifted down to its own size and place — a scroll-tied zoom-out parallax with no curve. A photo breather placed between section texts

options.y: Initial downward offset (% of photo height), default 40%
options.start · end: ScrollTrigger position, default top top · bottom top
options.min: At this width (px) or below nothing moves, only the fixed window, default 1024
options.--fx-top: Top offset of the fixed panel (css variable), default 0 — the original sits 100px below the header row

from.where: index.html .og-window (three photo slots behind the Nature · Dining · Rooms sections — original .p-index_parallax-bg clip-path inset(0) · __inner fixed top 100px · __bg fromTo scale 1.2 y 40% → 1 0%, start top top end bottom top, scrub, 1025px and up)
